description: Four oscillators — sine, saw, triangle and square — tuned in whole octaves from a shared pitch jack, each with its own volume, and all four summed again through a resampling stage

params.text: Sets the octave of the sine oscillator, four octaves either side of C4 at 261.63Hz, in whole steps
Sets the octave of the saw oscillator, four octaves either side of C4 at 261.63Hz, in whole steps
Sets the octave of the triangle oscillator, four octaves either side of C4 at 261.63Hz, in whole steps
Sets the octave of the square oscillator, four octaves either side of C4 at 261.63Hz, in whole steps
Sets how far the FM in jack moves the pitch of all four oscillators, -0.7 to 1.23 octaves per volt, and at 0 that jack has no effect
Crossfades the sine output between the plain sine and a folded waveshaped version, -0.5 to 1.5; at 0 the sine passes unshaped
Crossfades the saw output between the plain ramp and a folded waveshaped version, -0.5 to 1; at 0 the ramp passes unshaped
Crossfades the triangle output between the plain triangle and a folded waveshaped version, -0.5 to 1; at 0 the triangle passes unshaped
Scales the voltage at the central MoD jack before it reaches the sine, saw and triangle shaping, -0.5 to 1; with that jack unpatched the knob changes nothing
Scales the FM Amount jack before that voltage is added to the FM Input knob, -0.5 to 0.6; the setting is applied twice in the code, so the jack arrives multiplied by the square of it
Scales the sine output, 0 to 1, and scales the sine's share of the Resample output
Scales the saw output, 0 to 1, and scales the saw's share of the Resample output
Scales the triangle output, 0 to 1, and scales the triangle's share of the Resample output
Scales the square output, 0 to 1, and scales the square's share of the Resample output
Multiplies the voltage at the Resample jack, 0 to 0.8; that product is both the resampling rate and the final gain of the Resample output, so at 0 that output is silent

inputs.text: One volt per octave added to the sine oscillator's octave knob
One volt per octave added to the saw oscillator's octave knob
One volt per octave added to the triangle oscillator's octave knob
One volt per octave added to the square oscillator's octave knob
Frequency modulation for all four oscillators at once, scaled by the FM Input knob and added in octaves, so the modulation is exponential rather than linear
Scaled by the square of the FM Amount knob and added to the FM Input knob, varying how far the FM in jack moves the pitch
Added volt for volt to the Saw Psychedelic knob, shaping the saw further
Scaled by the Psychedelic CV knob and fed to all three waveshaping controls; the sine takes it scaled by the Sine Waveshaper knob too, the triangle takes it inverted
Added volt for volt to the Triangle Psychedelic knob, shaping the triangle further
Multiplied by the Resample knob to give both the resampling rate and the gain of the Resample output; with nothing patched here that output stays at 0V
One volt per octave added to the octave knob of all four oscillators at once

outputs.text: The sine wave, -5V to 5V at full Sine Volume with the Sine Waveshaper knob at 0
The saw ramp, 0 to 10V at full Saw Volume with the Saw Psychedelic knob at 0, running upward from zero rather than either side of it
The triangle wave, -5V to 5V at full Triangle Volume with the Triangle Psychedelic knob at 0
The square wave, -5V to 5V at full Square Volume; no waveshaping control is applied to it
The four waveform outputs added together, multiplied by a resampled square built from the same four phases and then by the Resample jack times the Resample knob, with no limiting

notes: The Resample output is silent until a cable is patched into the Resample jack: its level is that jack's voltage times the Resample knob, and an unpatched jack reads 0V.
Every jack on the module is monophonic; only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is read.
None of the four waveforms is anti-aliased. Each is built straight from a wrapping phase counter.
The module has no menu of its own beyond Rack's.
